scope: Audited authored WASM compatibility surface against selected MSL 4.1 specification families; not a complete language conformance census.

statusLegend.partial: Authored source implementation exists for explicitly listed subset; does not imply exact-head compiler or device success.
statusLegend.not_covered: No declared implementation or qualifying test found in audited surface; parser/backend support must be probed, not assumed absent.
statusLegend.passed_ci: Fresh exact-head Linux compiler suite passed the specifically configured subset; no automatic promotion to Apple/device layers.
statusLegend.passed: The named layer passed for its documented case scope.
statusLegend.failed: At least one covered case failed at this layer; see details for partial passes and cause.
statusLegend.completed: GPU commands completed for reported attempted entries; does not mean all entry points or numerical checks passed.
statusLegend.not_run: Harness exists or stage is applicable but no execution result for this exact head was supplied.
statusLegend.not_covered_layer: No current harness coverage for that layer; cannot become passed or pending from another row.

selectedDirection: Implement and validate genuine Metal 4.1; baseline remains the existing metal3.2 frontend with iOS 18/26 targets.

features.implementedScope: Baseline v1/v2 accept iOS 18/26 and select metal3.2 for both. iOS 26 AIR/MSL 2.7/3.2 disagrees with metallib VERS 2.8/4.0. Staged explicit v3 tuples are separate and unbuilt.
features.existingValidation: Direct source inspection of API and Apple flags. Inherited frontend has metal41 and MetalVersion=410, but the public WASM API does not select it. Newer C++/GNU/OpenCL flags require language-restriction audit.
features.nextValidation: Build and validate staged explicit v3 tuples 18/320,26/400,27/410; check macros and actual AIR/VERS agreement. Track legacy iOS 26 mismatch separately: it is not fixed by v3 or qualified by loader success.
